content.short: We are a coalition of SPOs, whose energy goes solely into creating a better Cardano.
content.description:
Leveraging open source code and the Cardano Community at large, FreeLoaderz is constantly working towards a free and Decentralized Cardano. We began with our Load Balancer, combined with Spo's redundent relays, in order to access the blockchain at a more reliable and higher tx's throughput, Accessing what already existed on Cardano but in a way that harnessed the true nature of Cardanos Ethos. From there we are adding to our FreeLoaderz ecosystem by creating a dynamic web3 token distribution platform, this in no way will be just any token dist. platform as it will allow for both standard end user token claimz as well as enterprise level volume distribution as well.

Of course thats not all we are doing, as in keeping with the FreeLoaderz Ethos "A Blockchain for everyone" we will be empowering our low saturated stake pools with enough ada to mint blocks every epoch, through our treasury funding efforts. This is no small endeavour but considering in the few short months since inception we have grown to over 500 community members, of which a large portion are Developers, Entreprenuers, Retired CEO'S, multiple PHD holders, I'd say we have more then enough community members to handle anything that comes our way.

In short "We are Cardano" and that spirit of empowering those, who from no fault of their own, find themselves with less the best enviroment to see them succeed. Those are who we truly work for and whos lives we impact today, will exponentially impact in a very positive and lasting way, all of those around them.
